passages.text: On the first day of the second month of the second year after the Israelites had come out of the land of Egypt, the LORD spoke to Moses in the Tent of Meeting in the Wilderness of Sinai. He said: “Take a census of the whole congregation of Israel by their clans and families, listing every man by name, one by one.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
This happened in the Wilderness of Sinai.
Moses was in the Tent of Meeting.
It was the first day of the second month.
It was the second year after the Israelites left Egypt.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
He said, “Count all the people of Israel.
Count them by their clans.
Count them by their families.
List every man by name.
List each man one by one.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֨ר יְהוָ֧ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֛ה בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינַ֖י בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד בְּאֶחָד֩ לַחֹ֨דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֜י בַּשָּׁנָ֣ה הַשֵּׁנִ֗ית לְצֵאתָ֛ם מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם לֵאמֹֽר׃ שְׂא֗וּ אֶת־ רֹאשׁ֙ כָּל־ עֲדַ֣ת בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֔וֹת כָּל־ זָכָ֖ר לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: You and Aaron are to number those who are twenty years of age or older by their divisions—everyone who can serve in Israel’s army.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God spoke in the Wilderness of Sinai.
God spoke in the Tent of Meeting.
God gave Moses a command.
Aaron must help Moses.
Moses and Aaron must count the men of Israel.
They must count every man who is twenty years old or older.
They must count every man who can serve in Israel’s army.
They must organize the men by their divisions.
passages.original: מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כָּל־ יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל תִּפְקְד֥וּ אֹתָ֛ם לְצִבְאֹתָ֖ם אַתָּ֥ה וְאַהֲרֹֽן׃

passages.text: And one man from each tribe, the head of each family, must be there with you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses in the Wilderness of Sinai.
God spoke in the Tent of Meeting.
God gave Moses instructions for a census of Israel.
God told Moses to count all the men of Israel who could serve in the army.
God said to count men twenty years old and older.
God told Moses and Aaron to do this work together.
God said that one man from each tribe must help Moses and Aaron.
Each man must be the leader of his family.
Each man must be the head of his father's house.
Each tribe must have its leader present with Moses and Aaron.
passages.original: וְאִתְּכֶ֣ם יִהְי֔וּ אִ֥ישׁ אִ֖ישׁ לַמַּטֶּ֑ה אִ֛ישׁ רֹ֥אשׁ לְבֵית־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו הֽוּא׃

passages.text: These are the names of the men who are to assist you: From the tribe of Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur; from Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai; from Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab; from Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar; from Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon; from the sons of Joseph: from Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud, and from Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur; from Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni; from Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai; from Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran; from Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel; and from Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan.”
passages.sermon:
These are the names of the men who will assist you.
Each man is the leader of his tribe and family in Israel.
From the tribe of Reuben, Elizur son of Shedeur will assist you.
From the tribe of Simeon, Shelumiel son of Zurishaddai will assist you.
From the tribe of Judah, Nahshon son of Amminadab will assist you.
From the tribe of Issachar, Nethanel son of Zuar will assist you.
From the tribe of Zebulun, Eliab son of Helon will assist you.
From the sons of Joseph, two men will assist you.
From the tribe of Ephraim, Elishama son of Ammihud will assist you.
From the tribe of Manasseh, Gamaliel son of Pedahzur will assist you.
From the tribe of Benjamin, Abidan son of Gideoni will assist you.
From the tribe of Dan, Ahiezer son of Ammishaddai will assist you.
From the tribe of Asher, Pagiel son of Ocran will assist you.
From the tribe of Gad, Eliasaph son of Deuel will assist you.
From the tribe of Naphtali, Ahira son of Enan will assist you.
passages.original: וְאֵ֙לֶּה֙ שְׁמ֣וֹת הָֽאֲנָשִׁ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר יַֽעַמְד֖וּ אִתְּכֶ֑ם לִרְאוּבֵ֕ן אֱלִיצ֖וּר בֶּן־ שְׁדֵיאֽוּר׃ לְשִׁמְע֕וֹן שְׁלֻמִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּרִֽישַׁדָּֽי׃ לִֽיהוּדָ֕ה נַחְשׁ֖וֹן בֶּן־ עַמִּינָדָֽב׃ לְיִ֨שָּׂשכָ֔ר נְתַנְאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ צוּעָֽר׃ לִזְבוּלֻ֕ן אֱלִיאָ֖ב בֶּן־ חֵלֹֽן׃ לִבְנֵ֣י יוֹסֵ֔ף לְאֶפְרַ֕יִם אֱלִישָׁמָ֖ע בֶּן־ עַמִּיה֑וּד לִמְנַשֶּׁ֕ה גַּמְלִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ פְּדָהצֽוּר׃ לְבִ֨נְיָמִ֔ן אֲבִידָ֖ן בֶּן־ גִּדְעֹנִֽי׃ לְדָ֕ן אֲחִיעֶ֖זֶר בֶּן־ עַמִּֽישַׁדָּֽי׃ לְאָשֵׁ֕ר פַּגְעִיאֵ֖ל בֶּן־ עָכְרָֽן׃ לְגָ֕ד אֶלְיָסָ֖ף בֶּן־ דְּעוּאֵֽל׃ לְנַ֨פְתָּלִ֔י אֲחִירַ֖ע בֶּן־ עֵינָֽן׃

passages.text: These men were appointed from the congregation; they were the leaders of the tribes of their fathers, the heads of the clans of Israel.
passages.sermon: These men were chosen from the people of Israel.\r\nThey were leaders of their fathers’ tribes.\r\nThey were heads of the clans of Israel.
passages.original: אֵ֚לֶּה קְרִיאֵי הָעֵדָ֔ה נְשִׂיאֵ֖י מַטּ֣וֹת אֲבוֹתָ֑ם רָאשֵׁ֛י אַלְפֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הֵֽם׃

passages.text: So Moses and Aaron took these men who had been designated by name, and on the first day of the second month they assembled the whole congregation and recorded their ancestry by clans and families, counting one by one the names of those twenty years of age or older, just as the LORD had commanded Moses. So Moses numbered them in the Wilderness of Sinai: From the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Reuben numbered 46,500.
passages.sermon:
Moses and Aaron led the people of Israel.
They took the men who had been chosen by name.
These men were leaders from each tribe.
On the first day of the second month, Moses and Aaron gathered the whole congregation.
They assembled everyone together.
They recorded the ancestry of the people.
They listed each family by its clan and by its father's house.
They counted the names of all the men.
They counted every man who was twenty years old or older.
They counted each man one by one.
They did everything as the LORD had commanded Moses.
Moses counted the people in the Wilderness of Sinai.
He began with the tribe of Reuben.
Reuben was the firstborn son of Israel.
Moses recorded the families and clans of Reuben.
He counted every male from the tribe of Reuben who was twenty years old or older.
He counted every man who could serve in the army.
The total number of men from the tribe of Reuben was 46,500.
passages.original: וַיִּקַּ֥ח מֹשֶׁ֖ה וְאַהֲרֹ֑ן אֵ֚ת הָאֲנָשִׁ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִקְּב֖וּ בְּשֵׁמֽוֹת׃ וְאֵ֨ת כָּל־ הָעֵדָ֜ה הִקְהִ֗ילוּ בְּאֶחָד֙ לַחֹ֣דֶשׁ הַשֵּׁנִ֔י וַיִּתְיַֽלְד֥וּ עַל־ מִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֛ה וָמַ֖עְלָה לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָֽם׃ כַּאֲשֶׁ֛ר צִוָּ֥ה יְהוָ֖ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֑ה וַֽיִּפְקְדֵ֖ם בְּמִדְבַּ֥ר סִינָֽי׃פ וַיִּהְי֤וּ בְנֵֽי־ רְאוּבֵן֙ בְּכֹ֣ר יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם כָּל־ זָכָ֗ר מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה רְאוּבֵ֑ן שִׁשָּׁ֧ה וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: From the sons of Simeon, according to the records of their clans and families, counting one by one the names of every male twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Simeon numbered 59,300.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Simeon belonged to one of the tribes of Israel.
They had their own clans and families.
Moses and Aaron counted them by their families and by their fathers’ houses.
They listed every male who was twenty years old or older.
They counted only those who could serve in the army.
They recorded each name one by one.
The total number of men registered from the tribe of Simeon was 59,300.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י שִׁמְע֔וֹן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם פְּקֻדָ֗יו בְּמִסְפַּ֤ר שֵׁמוֹת֙ לְגֻלְגְּלֹתָ֔ם כָּל־ זָכָ֗ר מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה שִׁמְע֑וֹן תִּשְׁעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: From the sons of Gad, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Gad numbered 45,650.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Gad belonged to one of the tribes of Israel.
They had clans and families.
Moses and Aaron counted them by their families and by their fathers’ houses.
They counted every male who was twenty years old or older.
These men could serve in the army.
They wrote down each name.
The total number of men registered from the tribe of Gad was 45,650.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י גָ֔ד תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה גָ֑ד חֲמִשָּׁ֤ה וְאַרְבָּעִים֙ אֶ֔לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃פ

passages.text: From the sons of Judah, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Judah numbered 74,600.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Judah formed one of the tribes of Israel.
Judah was a son of Jacob.
The tribe of Judah had many families.
Each family belonged to a clan.
Leaders kept records of these families and clans.
They counted the men in the tribe of Judah.
They counted only the men who were twenty years old or older.
They counted only the men who could serve in the army.
They listed each man by name.
The total number of men registered in the tribe of Judah was 74,600.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יְהוּדָ֔ה תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה יְהוּדָ֑ה אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וְשִׁבְעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְשֵׁ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: From the sons of Issachar, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Issachar numbered 54,400.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Issachar formed a tribe in Israel.
They had clans and families.
Leaders kept records of their families and clans.
They counted the names of the men.
They counted only those who were twenty years old or older.
They counted only those who could serve in the army.
The tribe of Issachar had 54,400 men who could serve in the army.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י יִשָּׂשכָ֔ר תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה יִשָּׂשכָ֑ר אַרְבָּעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: From the sons of Zebulun, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Zebulun numbered 57,400.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Zebulun belonged to the tribe of Zebulun.
They had clans and families.
Leaders kept records of their families and clans.
They counted the names of all men who were twenty years old or older.
These men could serve in the army.
The total number of men registered from the tribe of Zebulun was 57,400.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י זְבוּלֻ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה זְבוּלֻ֑ן שִׁבְעָ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: From the sons of Joseph: From the sons of Ephraim, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Ephraim numbered 40,500.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Joseph included the sons of Ephraim.
The leaders recorded the families and clans of Ephraim.
They counted the names of all men from Ephraim who were twenty years old or older.
These men could serve in the army.
The total number of men registered from the tribe of Ephraim was 40,500.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֤י יוֹסֵף֙ לִבְנֵ֣י אֶפְרַ֔יִם תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אֶפְרָ֑יִם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: And from the sons of Manasseh, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Manasseh numbered 32,200.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Manasseh formed a tribe in Israel.
They belonged to different clans and families.
Leaders kept records of their families.
They counted the names of all men in the tribe.
They counted only men who were twenty years old or older.
They counted only those who could serve in the army.
The total number of men registered in the tribe of Manasseh was 32,200.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י מְנַשֶּׁ֔ה תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמ֗וֹת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה מְנַשֶּׁ֑ה שְׁנַ֧יִם וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּמָאתָֽיִם׃פ

passages.text: From the sons of Benjamin, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Benjamin numbered 35,400.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Benjamin formed one of the tribes of Israel.
The tribe of Benjamin had many families and clans.
Leaders kept records of each family and clan in the tribe.
They counted the names of all men in the tribe of Benjamin.
They counted only men who were twenty years old or older.
They counted only men who could serve in the army.
The total number of men registered in the tribe of Benjamin was 35,400.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י בִנְיָמִ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה בִנְיָמִ֑ן חֲמִשָּׁ֧ה וּשְׁלֹשִׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: From the sons of Dan, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Dan numbered 62,700.
passages.sermon:
The tribe of Dan was one of the tribes of Israel.
The sons of Dan belonged to different clans and families.
Moses and Aaron counted the men of Dan.
They used records of each clan and family.
They counted every man who was twenty years old or older.
They counted only those who could serve in the army.
The total number of men registered from the tribe of Dan was 62,700.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י דָ֔ן תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה דָ֑ן שְׁנַ֧יִם וְשִׁשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁבַ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: From the sons of Asher, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Asher numbered 41,500.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Asher belonged to the tribe of Israel.
They had clans and families.
Leaders kept records of their families.
They counted the names of the men.
They counted only men who were twenty years old or older.
These men could serve in the army.
The tribe of Asher had 41,500 men who could serve in the army.
passages.original: לִבְנֵ֣י אָשֵׁ֔ר תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אָשֵׁ֑ר אֶחָ֧ד וְאַרְבָּעִ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: From the sons of Naphtali, according to the records of their clans and families, counting the names of all those twenty years of age or older who could serve in the army, those registered to the tribe of Naphtali numbered 53,400.
passages.sermon:
The sons of Naphtali belonged to the tribe of Naphtali.
They had families and clans.
Leaders kept records of their families and clans.
They counted the names of all men in the tribe of Naphtali.
They counted only men who were twenty years old or older.
They counted only men who could serve in the army.
The total number of men registered from the tribe of Naphtali was 53,400.
passages.original: בְּנֵ֣י נַפְתָּלִ֔י תּוֹלְדֹתָ֥ם לְמִשְׁפְּחֹתָ֖ם לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם בְּמִסְפַּ֣ר שֵׁמֹ֗ת מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כֹּ֖ל יֹצֵ֥א צָבָֽא׃ פְּקֻדֵיהֶ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה נַפְתָּלִ֑י שְׁלֹשָׁ֧ה וַחֲמִשִּׁ֛ים אֶ֖לֶף וְאַרְבַּ֥ע מֵאֽוֹת׃פ

passages.text: These were the men numbered by Moses and Aaron, with the assistance of the twelve leaders of Israel, each one representing his family.
passages.sermon: Moses and Aaron counted the men of Israel.\r\nTwelve leaders of Israel helped them.\r\nEach leader represented his own family.
passages.original: אֵ֣לֶּה הַפְּקֻדִ֡ים אֲשֶׁר֩ פָּקַ֨ד מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאַהֲרֹן֙ וּנְשִׂיאֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל שְׁנֵ֥ים עָשָׂ֖ר אִ֑ישׁ אִישׁ־ אֶחָ֥ד לְבֵית־ אֲבֹתָ֖יו הָיֽוּ׃

passages.text: So all the Israelites twenty years of age or older who could serve in Israel’s army were counted according to their families.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites were the descendants of Jacob.
They belonged to different families.
Moses counted the Israelites.
He counted only those who were twenty years old or older.
He counted only those who could serve in Israel’s army.
He counted them according to their families.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְי֛וּ כָּל־ פְּקוּדֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל לְבֵ֣ית אֲבֹתָ֑ם מִבֶּ֨ן עֶשְׂרִ֤ים שָׁנָה֙ וָמַ֔עְלָה כָּל־ יֹצֵ֥א צָבָ֖א בְּיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: And all those counted totaled 603,550.
passages.sermon:
Moses and Aaron counted the men of Israel.
The leaders of the twelve tribes helped them.
They counted every man who could serve in the army.
They counted only men who were twenty years old or older.
They did not count the Levites.
The total number of men counted was 603,550.
passages.original: וַיִּֽהְיוּ֙ כָּל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים שֵׁשׁ־ מֵא֥וֹת אֶ֖לֶף וּשְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים וַחֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת וַחֲמִשִּֽׁים׃

passages.text: The Levites, however, were not numbered along with them by the tribe of their fathers.
passages.sermon:
The Levites belonged to the tribe of Levi.
The Levites had fathers from the tribe of Levi.
The Levites were not counted with the other Israelites.
The Levites were not included in the census.
passages.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם לְמַטֵּ֣ה אֲבֹתָ֑ם לֹ֥א הָתְפָּקְד֖וּ בְּתוֹכָֽם׃פ

passages.text: For the LORD had said to Moses: “Do not number the tribe of Levi in the census with the other Israelites.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses a command.
The LORD said, “Do not count the tribe of Levi.
Do not include the Levites in the census.
Do not number them among the other Israelites.
The Levites are not to be counted with the other tribes of Israel.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ אַ֣ךְ אֶת־ מַטֵּ֤ה לֵוִי֙ לֹ֣א תִפְקֹ֔ד וְאֶת־ רֹאשָׁ֖ם לֹ֣א תִשָּׂ֑א בְּת֖וֹךְ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

passages.text: Instead, you are to appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony, all its furnishings, and everything in it. They shall carry the tabernacle and all its articles, care for it, and camp around it.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a special tribe in Israel.
God chose the Levites for a special task.
You must appoint the Levites over the tabernacle of the Testimony.
The tabernacle is the holy tent where God meets His people.
The Levites must take care of all the furnishings of the tabernacle.
The Levites must take care of everything that belongs to the tabernacle.
The Levites must carry the tabernacle.
The Levites must carry all the articles of the tabernacle.
The Levites must serve the tabernacle.
The Levites must camp around the tabernacle.
passages.original: וְאַתָּ֡ה הַפְקֵ֣ד אֶת־ הַלְוִיִּם֩ עַל־ מִשְׁכַּ֨ן הָעֵדֻ֜ת וְעַ֣ל כָּל־ כֵּלָיו֮ וְעַ֣ל כָּל־ אֲשֶׁר־ לוֹ֒ הֵ֜מָּה יִשְׂא֤וּ אֶת־ הַמִּשְׁכָּן֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְהֵ֖ם יְשָׁרְתֻ֑הוּ וְסָבִ֥יב לַמִּשְׁכָּ֖ן יַחֲנֽוּ׃

passages.text: Whenever the tabernacle is to move, the Levites are to take it down, and whenever it is to be pitched, the Levites are to set it up. Any outsider who goes near it must be put to death.
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a special tribe in Israel.
God gave the Levites a unique duty.
The Levites must care for the tabernacle.
The tabernacle is the holy tent where God meets His people.
When the Israelites move, the Levites must take down the tabernacle.
When the Israelites stop, the Levites must set up the tabernacle.
Only the Levites may handle the tabernacle.
If any outsider comes near the tabernacle, that person must be put to death.
passages.original: וּבִנְסֹ֣עַ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֗ן יוֹרִ֤ידוּ אֹתוֹ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם וּבַחֲנֹת֙ הַמִּשְׁכָּ֔ן יָקִ֥ימוּ אֹת֖וֹ הַלְוִיִּ֑ם וְהַזָּ֥ר הַקָּרֵ֖ב יוּמָֽת׃

passages.text: The Israelites are to camp by their divisions, each man in his own camp and under his own standard.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites must camp together as a group.
Each man must stay in his own camp.
Each man must remain under his own standard.
Each group must stay with its own division.
passages.original: וְחָנ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אִ֧ישׁ עַֽל־ מַחֲנֵ֛הוּ וְאִ֥ישׁ עַל־ דִּגְל֖וֹ לְצִבְאֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: But the Levites are to camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony and watch over it, so that no wrath will fall on the congregation of Israel. So the Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony.”
passages.sermon:
The Levites are a special group from the people of Israel.
The Levites must camp around the tabernacle of the Testimony.
The tabernacle of the Testimony is the holy tent where God meets with His people.
The Levites must guard the tabernacle of the Testimony.
The Levites must watch over it carefully.
If the Levites do this, no wrath will come on the congregation of Israel.
The Levites are responsible for the tabernacle of the Testimony.
passages.original: וְהַלְוִיִּ֞ם יַחֲנ֤וּ סָבִיב֙ לְמִשְׁכַּ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֔ת וְלֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֣ה קֶ֔צֶף עַל־ עֲדַ֖ת בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְשָׁמְרוּ֙ הַלְוִיִּ֔ם אֶת־ מִשְׁמֶ֖רֶת מִשְׁכַּ֥ן הָעֵדֽוּת׃

passages.text: Thus the Israelites did everything just as the LORD had commanded Moses.
passages.sermon:
The Israelites are God's chosen people.
God gave commands to Moses.
God told Moses what the people must do.
The Israelites obeyed God.
They did everything God commanded through Moses.
They followed all of God's instructions.
passages.original: וַֽיַּעֲשׂ֖וּ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל כְּ֠כֹל אֲשֶׁ֨ר צִוָּ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֖ה כֵּ֥ן עָשֽׂוּ׃פ
